title: A timed-out file read leaves the work running
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/upload-pipeline.ts withTimeout raced extractFromPdf, resizeImage and docxToText against a 30 s timer (EXTRACT_TIMEOUT); the timer rejected but the work ran on, with no abort. The late result never reached the review (Promise.race drops it; now pinned). Done: withTimeout aborts a signal at the limit; extractFromPdf destroys its pdf.js task then, docxToText stops before its next part; the photo resize is not stopped (short blob load, uninterruptible draw). US-12 AC7b. Local processing, not a cloud call; found by A1-6
